_comment: Map a product id (slug) -> a real Amazon ASIN to pull LIVE price/reviews/sellers via retailerapi (needs RETAILERAPI_KEY). Find the product on Amazon, copy its ASIN (B0...), add it here, then run `npm run research:daily -- --force`. retailerapi free tier is rate-limited and only covers ASINs in its index (some return 404) — add a few at a time.
